BiblicalUsage: They is a small word that points at the powers in Daniel's visions. In Daniel 2:44 the God of heaven shall set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed, and it shall break in pieces all these kingdoms, in Daniel 7:17 the angel says, these great beasts are four kings which shall arise out of the earth, and in Ezra 5:4 the governor asks, what are the names of the men that make this building.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word keeps the visions straight: they are the kings who rise, and the kingdom God sets up outlasts them all.
RelatedEvents: Rebuilding of the Temple; Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image
